assets.prompt: Edit the original Bespin gas albedo into a high-resolution square flat unlit game texture. Preserve orange ochre, tan and cream colors, original brightness, horizontal band positions and widths. Add restrained fine horizontal wispy gaseous detail within bands; no giant storms, new large features, sphere, space, glow, shadow, border or text. Left/right edges should wrap seamlessly. Requested 1024 square; generated source1254 square, imported1024 square.
assets.appearance: Preserves orange/cream band identity; generated detail, not recovered original detail.
